== Summary ==
Identified: [[Tamás Papp]] (blue shirt), [[Quirin Fürgut]] (Iron Empire tee; same face as [[:File:Quirin Fürgut 2023 European Championship.jpg]]), [[Lynden Pater]] (white tee, glasses), [[Emil Wallin]] (olive tee, blonde bun), and [[Chris Menzel]] (glasses, white beard). The man in the white Jack & Jones shirt (same person as the pink shirt in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 2.jpg]]) and some other diners are not named.

Closing meal at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, 3 June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date:''' 3 June 2023
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-06-04
* '''Identification:''' [[Tamás Papp]] (blue shirt), [[Quirin Fürgut]] (Iron Empire tee; same face as [[:File:Quirin Fürgut 2023 European Championship.jpg]]), [[Lynden Pater]] (white tee, glasses), [[Emil Wallin]] (olive tee, blonde bun), and [[Chris Menzel]] (glasses, white beard). The man in the white Jack & Jones shirt (same person as the pink shirt in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 2.jpg]]) and some other diners are not named.
